description: Request a price quote for one catalog service (service_id from catalog.search). Needs an API key with a quote mandate from your owner; the mandate's spending ceiling and daily quote limits apply. Repeating a client_reference returns the same quote instead of a new one. Supply configuration per catalog.order_schema.get. Returns quote_id, status, respond_by and list price; read the result later with quote.get. Does not place an order.

address.description: US service address: one line or structured

client_reference.description: Your idempotency key (8+ characters); reuse it to get the same quote back

confirm_request_id.description: confirm_request_id returned by availability.check (confirm: true); links the supplier confirmation request, which may still be pending

name: quote.request
